    Questions
    
        
    FAQ
    
        
    I've never coded or edited a video. Is this for me?
    Yes. You copy, paste and describe what you want. Claude writes the code; the guide shows you every click.
    
        
    Does it make realistic videos of people?
    No. It shines at motion design, illustration, animated characters, typography and explainers: the styles that dominate faceless accounts.
    
        
    What do I get exactly?
    A 55-page PDF (A4 and US Letter) with a clickable table of contents, the 56 prompts as a plain-text file, and a link to the free starter kit.
